titulo: Universal early childhood education better than baby bonus to increase Australia’s birthrate, Labor says
cuerpo: Intergenerational report predicts that in four decades’ time, more Australians will be dying than being born each year Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Labor says better investment in early childhood education and care, such as a possible move to universal access for families, is a better way to address Australia’s declining birthrate, rejecting the need for a new “baby bonus”. Monday’s intergenerational report showed that more Australians will be dying than being born in 40 years’ time, a point already reached by countries including South Korea, Italy, Germany and Japan.
